$comment: Spec 124 §5 R-BA gate I #34 (R-X) — every staleness.fingerprint_inputs entry declared by a converted step needs an adjudicated disposition row here: "executed" (a named executor.{file,symbol} genuinely reads it), "descriptive" (declared, documents intent, 0 readers today), or "retire" (dead, should be removed from the descriptor). Measured 2026-09-26: all 29 distinct entries across the 20 converted steps are 0-reader — every row below is "descriptive". A future step that wires a real executor over one of these entries must flip its row to "executed" with executor.{file,symbol} in the SAME commit (R-X: an unexecuted "executed" claim is a rotted citation, checked live by dispositionRowFindings).
